features: Longest streak replaces Overall mood within the selected Insights period; duplicate and future days are excluded.
Weekly, monthly and yearly Plus subscriptions unlock all premium themes, AI tags and recaps.
Botanical, Coastal and Sunset are permanent non-consumable purchases; original Pastel remains free.
Theme preference survives subscription expiry; unavailable themes fall back to Pastel without changing journal drafts.
PCC managed entitlement is present in the app entitlement file used by Debug and Release.
Website privacy policy draft and in-app policy include transfinite@transfinite.us.
Previous Today tag layout restored; tag suggestions still generate automatically for Plus.
PCC is enabled by default, with a persisted off switch in Customize. Failed cloud requests retry once on device; cancellation does not retry.
Native SubscriptionStoreView and ProductView load real product identifiers directly, including when the catalog is initially empty.
Hosted privacy-policy URL is configured in StoreKit policy links and local App Store Connect app-info metadata.

Existing journal persistence and synchronization regressions
PCC default/off persistence, cloud success/failure, local-only failure, cancellation, and failure of both models

verification.bitrigBuildResult: Simulator-target dependency build succeeded; signed Mac build failed on the managed PCC entitlement. No further retry attempted after the third identical provisioning failure.

limitations: Signed Bitrig build fails on Mac: Entitlement com.apple.developer.private-cloud-compute not found and could not be included in profile. Apple must assign the managed capability to the developer account/App ID/profile.

Bitrig refuses simulator inspection after edits until every target builds successfully. Further purchase-screen, PCC toggle and automatic-tag interaction checks are blocked by the Mac signing failure.
Six App Store Connect products are staged in local listing files, not applied remotely. App Review screenshots are still required; do not submit products without them.
Built-in simulator cannot complete real StoreKit sandbox purchases. Verify purchase, restore, expiry, cancellation and refunds on device after metadata setup.

Main-app SwiftData uses automatic CloudKit configuration with the entitled private container. Actual two-device iCloud sync is not verified by these isolated regression tests. Watch data remains local.
New store copy and policy are English; existing Arabic and Spanish localization is preserved and can be extended.
Hosted policy currently says AI never sends context to Private Cloud Compute. Replace its content with the updated Legal/PrivacyPolicy.txt draft before release.
